poam-items.title: AU-2: remediate failed hardening checks
poam-items.description: AU-2 (Event Logging) is not_implemented — failing: auditd service is not active; system calls are not being audited
poam-items.remarks: Install and enable the audit daemon: 'apt install auditd && systemctl enable --now auditd' (or the dnf equivalent).

poam-items.title: AU-12: remediate failed hardening checks
poam-items.description: AU-12 (Audit Record Generation) is partial — failing: auditd service is not active; system calls are not being audited
poam-items.remarks: Install and enable the audit daemon: 'apt install auditd && systemctl enable --now auditd' (or the dnf equivalent).

poam-items.title: IA-5: remediate failed hardening checks
poam-items.description: IA-5 (Authenticator Management) is partial — failing: PASS_MAX_DAYS is 99999; should be 365 or less; No minimum password length configured (checked /etc/login.defs PASS_MIN_LEN)
poam-items.remarks: Set 'PASS_MAX_DAYS 365' (or lower) in /etc/login.defs. Set 'minlen = 14' in /etc/security/pwquality.conf (libpwquality), or 'PASS_MIN_LEN 14' in /etc/login.defs on systems without pam_pwquality.

poam-items.title: SC-7: remediate failed hardening checks
poam-items.description: SC-7 (Boundary Protection) is not_implemented — failing: No firewall service is active (checked ufw, firewalld, nftables)
poam-items.remarks: Enable a host firewall, e.g. 'ufw enable' (Ubuntu) or 'systemctl enable --now firewalld' (RHEL), with a default-deny inbound policy.
